title: Development of hydrophobic catalysts for reducing the CO2 emission during the conversion of syngas into chemicals and fuels
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00731J, Review Article
Yanfei Xu, Mingyue Ding
This review systematically summarizes the research progress of hydrophobic catalysts for weakening the negative effect of water molecules on syngas conversion.
